label: Eventing Binding
type: the access-control/allow-list mechanism for an Eventing function - a function can only touch a bucket/scope/collection or call an external URL if a binding of the right type is configured; base type for eventing:bucket-alias-binding/url-alias-binding/constant-binding
note: Bindings, not capella-role:*/privilege:*, are the actual gate on what a deployed function can touch - eventing-rbac.md confirmed the management-plane privilege (Eventing Manage) only gates who can create/deploy/manage a function, never what it can access at runtime. Two genuinely distinct gating layers for the same feature.
